newsitem.title: THAILAND: FinOne group faces negative review-TRIS.
newsitem.headline: FinOne group faces negative review-TRIS.

text.p: Thai Rating and Information Services (TRIS) on Tuesday placed Finance One Plc and affiliates-- Securities One Plc and One Holding Plc -- on a negative ratings review.

TRIS said its decision "follows unfavourable developments within the group regarding liquidity and asset quality as well as weakened operating performance over recent years that led to the announcement of FIN1's planned merger with Thai Danu Bank Plc.

TRIS said despite Finance Once's large presence in the Thai finance industry, its business significantly relied on performance of the securities market which has faced a downturn in the past few years.
It said Thailand's recent economic slowdown especially in the property sector and eroded public sentiment of the financial sector added problems for the Finance One's finance business.
The credit rating agency said it will work with the Finance One group to review its future business and debt servicing outlook, especially its current 6.25 billion baht debts.
It said although Finance One's planned merger with Thai Danu appears to be in line with regulatory policy, details of the deal are still limited and it is subject to scrutiny by authorities.
